decision: Build src/core/effect-resource.ts — a pure, no-I/O module — owning the closed EffectKind union, EffectDeclaration/EffectResource types, the EffectSource injected port (in-memory now; Postgres DAO in T-0053), the classifyTool(declares) pure-compute linter, and verifyEffectGrants(declarations, grants, now, source, tenantId) gateway-verification function. Wire verification into grant-resolver.ts additively: one optional effects?: EffectSource field on ResolverDeps; a step 3.5 inside resolveFor active only when op === 'invoke' AND deps.effects is present. A null/malformed declares blob or any unsatisfied declaration returns { denied: true, reason: 'no_effect_grant' } fail-closed. object-handle.ts and grant-lattice.ts are byte-frozen (not edited). The new deny reason 'no_effect_grant' is defined in effect-resource.ts; the non-frozen composition path is used to widen ResolvedView at callers (e.g. ExtendedResolvedView type alias union) — coder chooses the tsc-clean mechanism. Migration 022_effect_resource.sql creates the per-tenant effect_resource table with tenant_id leading PK, ENABLE+FORCE RLS, kind CHECK constraint, and choros_app grant. ci/checks/effect-resource-isolation.sh provides the structural purity check. This is the exact T-0033 sibling seam (S-2): one more optional port on ResolverDeps, one more additive invoke-path step — no second resolver edge, single-resolver.sh stays green.

rejected_alternatives.option: Separate effect-resolver.ts — a second resolver entry-point for invoke-path
rejected_alternatives.why_not: Creates a second handle→fields edge; single-resolver.sh would fail. The verification must fold into the ONE resolveFor body (FR-8, AC-13). Two resolution paths diverge silently.

rejected_alternatives.option: Encode effect-grant check in object-handle.ts or grant-lattice.ts
rejected_alternatives.why_not: Both are byte-frozen (T-0015, T-0018). Adding a new authority dimension to frozen files breaks the byte-freeze invariant (AC-15) and couples unrelated concerns across task boundaries.

A second authority subsystem that drifts from the grant table. GT-1 hypothesis §5 explicitly requires effect_resource as a first-class resource_type in the EXISTING grant table — no separate permission subsystem (FR-1).

rejected_alternatives.option: Advisory declares text field — no gateway verification
rejected_alternatives.why_not: FR-4 requires gateway-verified, not advisory. Advisory text lets an agent claim any effect without a grant, defeating access control.

rejected_alternatives.option: Inline effect-check logic inside grant-resolver.ts (no separate effect-resource.ts)
rejected_alternatives.why_not: Couples the resolver to effect-declaration types and the linter, bloating its responsibility boundary. A separate pure module keeps types, linter, and verifier self-contained and re-importable by T-0043 without pulling in resolver internals.

contracts:
// src/core/effect-resource.ts — EffectKind closed union
export type EffectKind = "integration_endpoint" | "messaging_channel" | "external_account";

// src/core/effect-resource.ts — EffectDeclaration
export interface EffectDeclaration { resourceId: string; kind: EffectKind; }

// src/core/effect-resource.ts — EffectResource
export interface EffectResource { id: string; tenantId: string; kind: EffectKind; scope: unknown; metadata?: unknown; }

// src/core/effect-resource.ts — EffectSource port
export interface EffectSource { getEffect(tenantId: string, resourceId: string): EffectResource | null; }

// src/core/effect-resource.ts — ToolEffectProfile
export type ToolEffectProfile = { pure: true } | { pure: false; effects: EffectDeclaration[] };

fitness_functions.rule: Gateway denies invoke when subject lacks an effect-resource grant: resolveFor with EffectSource wired, normal grants present, tool declares effect E, subject holds no grant for E → { denied: true, reason: 'no_effect_grant' }. Malformed declares also denies fail-closed.
fitness_functions.ci_check: vitest run src/__tests__/effect-resource.test.ts — gateway-deny tests (AC-5, AC-9)

fitness_functions.rule: Gateway permits invoke when subject holds all declared effect-resource grants: resolveFor returns { denied: false, ... }.
All-or-nothing effect-grant check: 2-effect tool, subject holds 1 of 2 grants → denied fail-closed.

Backward compat (no effects port): resolveFor without effects in ResolverDeps behaves identically to pre-T-0034; step 3.5 is not entered; no no_effect_grant denial possible. All existing grant-resolver.test.ts pass unchanged.
fitness_functions.ci_check: vitest run src/__tests__/grant-resolver.test.ts (existing suite, no new flags) (AC-8)
